name: PSXGPT Serve first-turn document search v1

source.selection: First user run per session, excluding owner, local, and Codex accounts; selected for direct fact or source-page seeking
source.freshness_check: Stored history contains only the current user message and an empty assistant placeholder
source.privacy: No user, session, message, or trace identifiers are retained

purpose: Test whether Ledger behaves like a document search engine for real, fresh, fact-seeking questions.

judgment_policy.route: The controller should identify the named company, source collection, period, cadence, and independent search facets. It is not expected to plan calculations or an analyst answer.
judgment_policy.retrieval: Judge the visible result groups as search results: direct topical relevance, correct company and source collection, newest relevant evidence first, and coverage of every requested company or facet. Do not require the browser to calculate or synthesize an answer.
